raw_response:
The issuer exhibits extreme financial leverage with a debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 14.47 and severe liquidity strain from a current ratio of 0.63, indicating high default risk despite strong profitability margins. Negative retained earnings further undermine financial stability, placing it well into speculative grade without sufficient justification for investment-grade status.

DECISION: B-
